Retain visible magic and the fictional main woman.
preserved_choices: Night municipal lamplight maintenance on a wet canal bridge.

environment_detail.expressive_goal: Make ordinary civic infrastructure visibly usable while magic shares the same material scene.
observable_targets: Brass valve and visible connected gas pipe
Wet bridge masonry surrounding the utility
owner_relations: The fictional inspector acts on one stopcock inside the cabinet.

open_scope: Cabinet construction, pipe route and local wear may be clarified within existing scene.

environment_detail.scene_context: A fictional woman on a rain-dark stone canal bridge turns a valve; a pale spirit remains continuous with the exposed gas pipe while the connected lamp relights.
